title: Circular 96/2020/TT-BTC of the Ministry of Finance guiding information disclosure on the securities market (Thông tư 96/2020/TT-BTC hướng dẫn công bố thông tin trên thị trường chứng khoán)
citation: Thông tư 96/2020/TT-BTC ngày 16 tháng 11 năm 2020 của Bộ trưởng Bộ Tài chính
evidence: Thông tư này có hiệu lực thi hành kể từ ngày 01 tháng 01 năm 2021 và thay thế Thông tư số 155/2015/TT-BTC (Điều 40 of the text published in Công báo; Công báo page: "Ban hành: 16/11/2020 - Hiệu lực: 01/01/2021"). Opened https://congbao.chinhphu.vn/van-ban/thong-tu-so-96-2020-tt-btc-32793.htm on 2026-11-02.
notes: Annual-report disclosure duties of public companies and listed entities. The annual-report form (Phụ lục IV, Part II, item 6 "Báo cáo tác động liên quan đến môi trường và xã hội của công ty / Environment-Social-Governance (ESG) Report of the Company") lists total direct and indirect GHG emissions and measures to reduce them (item 6.1) in the as-published text and in the consolidated text (Phụ lục IV); this confirms the clause the earlier register note could not read. The forms carry English labels beside the Vietnamese lines; that is the official text and is stored as is. Stored: the circular as published (2021-01-01) and the consolidated text 10/VBHN-BTC signed 2026-04-20, which merges Circular 68/2024/TT-BTC (in force 2024-11-02), 18/2025/TT-BTC (2025-05-05) and 08/2026/TT-BTC (2026-02-03); its in_force is the date of the last of them. The states of 2024-11-02 and 2025-05-05 are not exposed as consolidated texts by Công báo (the State Securities Commission consolidation 41/VBHN-BTC of 2025 is on ssc.gov.vn, row VN-SSC-CONSOLIDATED, permission requested), so they have no record. The three amending circulars are not separate scope entries. The Government portal copy (chinhphu.vn, https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/12/96-btc.pdf) is a scanned image PDF (107 pages, no text layer) and was not used. No government English translation reachable: looked for at vietnamlaw.gov.vn and phapluat.gov.vn (403 to curl and to headless Chromium from the cloud address), vbpl.vn (the 'Xem văn bản tiếng Anh' view needs its data gateway, which resets the connection), and congbao.chinhphu.vn (Vietnamese only; no English edition or link on its pages).
